pages.title: What is Nourished?
pages.text: Nourished adds a $(bold)nutrition system$() to Minecraft that rewards dietary variety with real gameplay benefits.$(br2)Eat a wide variety of foods, maintain a balanced diet, and earn passive bonuses. Neglect entire food groups and your nutrition will slowly work against you.$(br2)$(italic)The more varied your diet, the better it works for you.$()

pages.title: Six Food Groups
pages.text: Nourished tracks $(bold)six core dietary groups$():$(br2)$(li)$(c:#ff6b6b)Fruits$()$(li)$(c:#6bff6b)Vegetables$()$(li)$(c:#ff9f6b)Proteins$()$(li)$(c:#ffef6b)Grains$()$(li)$(c:#ff6bef)Sugars$()$(li)$(c:#6bdfff)Dairy$()$(br2)Every food you eat contributes to one or more of these groups. Your goal is to keep all six balanced.
